title: Tadabbur and fluency: the scenes of the Day in Ya-Sin 49 to 56: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 32 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Tadabbur and fluency rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 32. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Ayat
Scene
rows: One blast; no time to make a will
The Horn; rising from graves; the saktah
All brought present; no soul wronged
The people of Paradise in joy

arabic.text: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ (٥٣) فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ (٥٤) إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ (٥٥) هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ (٥٦)

questions.q: Model tadabbur on 36:54 together (Point, Evidence, Explain, Link).
questions.a: Point: Allah's justice is perfect. Evidence: 36:54. Explain: no one is wronged or punished for another's deed. Link: I will be fair to others.

questions.q: Portal response box: a tadabbur paragraph on one scene with Point, Evidence, Explain, Link. Today's rota group recites 36:41 to 56.
questions.a: A paragraph citing an ayah and one realistic action.

questions.q: Extend: recite 36:49 to 56 at a steady pace, saktah included.
Which scene comes immediately after the Horn is blown (36:51)?
options: People hasten from their graves to their Lord
questions.a: A) People hasten from their graves to their Lord. 36:51.
the joy of the people of Paradise
options: the joy of the people of Paradise

questions.q: Think again: If you had to describe the Day of Resurrection in four scenes, which four would you choose from these ayat?
questions.a: The blast (49 to 50), the Horn and rising (51 to 52), all brought present and judged (53 to 54), the joy of Paradise (55 to 56).
